description: This file defines the ConsoleAPI class for interacting with a browser automation context, including methods for querying elements, inspecting, generating locators, and managing the Playwright object within the window. It also defines a Locator class for building complex selectors.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: A class for constructing complex element locators with various filtering options and methods for chaining and combining locators.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the Playwright API into the window object if not already present, providing methods for element selection, inspection, locator generation, and aria snapshot.

methods.name: _querySelector
methods.description: Queries a single element based on a selector string, with strict mode option.

methods.name: _querySelectorAll
methods.description: Queries all elements matching a selector string.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Inspects an element by passing it to the window's inspect function.

methods.name: _selector
methods.description: Generates a selector string for a given element.

methods.name: _generateLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator object for a given element and optional language.

methods.name: _resume
methods.description: Resumes execution if a resume function is available in the window.
